# Attio | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Migrating from a table to the first CRM | Validate that migrating from a form to the first CRM really reduces manual maintenance with the “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” primary link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Product-driven B2B sales | Verify that product-driven B2B sales are really reducing manual maintenance with “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Investor/Partnership Management | Verify that investor/partnership management really reduces manual maintenance with the “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| AI-assisted account research and follow-up | Use “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities — Advancing Phase — Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the primary link to verify that AI agent-assisted account research and follow-up really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
